title: This, that, here, there
description: Point to things near and far, and use the matching words for here, there, now, then, this way and so much.

guide.title: Three pointers: e-, o-, she-
guide.text:
Bengali has three pointing roots, and a whole family of words is built on each.

এ- (e-) is 'this': near the speaker.
ও- (o-) is 'that': away from the speaker but in sight, something you can point at.
সে- (she-) is 'that': the one already mentioned, usually not in sight.

Before a noun they appear as এই (ei), ওই (oi) and সেই (shei), and the noun normally takes the definite ending -টা: এই বইটা 'this book', ওই বাড়িটা 'that house', সেই লোকটা 'that man (we were talking about)'.

Standing alone, for a thing, they are এটা (etaa), ওটা (otaa), সেটা (shetaa): 'this one', 'that one', 'that / it'.

For several things: এগুলো (egulo) 'these', ওগুলো (ogulo) 'those', সেগুলো (shegulo).

guide.title: Here, there, this way, that way
guide.text:
The same three roots give the place words:

এখানে (ekhaane) here - ওখানে (okhaane) there (in sight) - সেখানে (shekhaane) there (the place mentioned)
এদিকে (edike) this way, over here - ওদিকে (odike) that way, over there

'From here' is এখান থেকে (ekhaan theke), without the final -e: the ending -e is the 'at' ending and থেকে replaces it.

The question words belong to the same pattern with ক-: কোথায় (where), কোনদিকে (which way).

examples.english: How far is it from here?

guide.title: Now, then, like this, so much
guide.text:
More members of the family:

Time: এখন (ekhon) now - তখন (tokhon) then - কখন when?
Manner: এরকম (erokom) or এমন (emon) like this, such - ওরকম (orokom) like that - কেমন how?
Amount: এত (eto) this much, so much - অত (oto) or তত (toto) that much - কত how much?

এত is very common as an exclamation: এত দাম! 'so expensive!'; এত লোক! 'so many people!'

In এখন, এত and এমন the first vowel is the a of 'cat'.

examples.english: Give me another one like this.

phrases.note: After এই the noun normally takes -taa.
সেটা refers back to what was just said.
সেই: the man both speakers already know about.
The e of এত is the a of 'cat', and the final o is said.

phrases.english: Give me another one like this.
